subject: Setting up shiny app hosted through spark

messages.author: 46f128ab268eb15f
messages.subject: Setting up shiny app hosted through spark
parts:
Hello all, I have searched around for help on this but I am not finding anything clear on what to do. I was just given a login today for shiny app hosting through rstudio but am having trouble getting the app on there.

I loaded up http://spark.rstudio.com:8787/ and logged in with my given credentials. This is basically as far as I've gotten. I've tried to create directories as instructed in the welcome e-mail and put my R scripts in a folder there, but when I try to go to the site (http://spark.rstudio.com/jbredeweg21/name of folder) it says the site does not exist. Is there something I need to do to initialize the site? 

Also, when trying to install packages for instance I get

> install.packages("shiny",dependencies=T)
Installing package(s) into ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
Warning in install.packages :
  'lib = "/usr/local/lib/R/site-library"' is not writable
Would you like to use a personal library instead?  (y/n)

This is my first exposure to servers or hosting so I could just be too nubile to understand what I'm looking at but any insight would be greatly appreciated.

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Setting up shiny app hosted through spark
parts:
You need to create a folder named shinyApps, and put your application in subfolders under this app. They would then be available at the site address you specified.

Hope this is helpful.
